description: This file contains unit tests for the channels status output in a configuration-only context. It tests different scenarios involving plugin registration, token and Slack channel configurations, and status summaries. It relies on the 'vitest' testing framework and references multiple internal modules related to channel plugins and their configurations.

methods.name: function registerSingleTestPlugin(pluginId: string, plugin: ChannelPlugin) { registerSingleTestPlugin
methods.description: Registers a single plugin as active in the test registry with specified pluginId.

methods.name: async function formatLocalStatusSummary( formatLocalStatusSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously formats the configuration channels status lines for local mode with optional source configuration.

methods.name: function unresolvedTokenAccount() { unresolvedTokenAccount
methods.description: Creates an object representing an unresolved token account with specific properties.

methods.name: function tokenOnlyPluginConfig() { tokenOnlyPluginConfig
methods.description: Provides a configuration object for a token-only plugin, with account ID methods.

methods.name: function makeUnavailableTokenPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { makeUnavailableTokenPlugin
methods.description: Creates a plugin instance representing a token-only plugin with unavailable token status.

methods.name: function makeResolvedTokenPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { makeResolvedTokenPlugin
methods.description: Creates a token-only plugin instance with resolved token information.

methods.name: function makeResolvedTokenPluginWithoutInspectAccount(): ChannelPlugin { makeResolvedTokenPluginWithoutInspectAccount
methods.description: Creates a token-only plugin instance without the ability to inspect account details.

methods.name: function makeUnavailableHttpSlackPlugin(): ChannelPlugin { makeUnavailableHttpSlackPlugin
methods.description: Creates a Slack plugin instance with unavailable signing secret for HTTP mode.

methods.name: function expectResolvedTokenStatusSummary( expectResolvedTokenStatusSummary
methods.description: Helper to assert that the token status summary contains specific details, especially for resolved tokens.
